about: By-eye phase times (s) from frame-by-frame contact sheets (devtools/sheet.ts). start = first frame of the continuous service motion after the ready pause; trophy = toss arm up, racket arm cocked, knees most bent, feet still down; racketDrop = racket lowest behind the back; contact = racket meets ball; landing = first foot touches down. Precision about ±1 frame, ±2 frames for start and trophy.
